profile.name: Aditya Rane
profile.tagline: I build intelligent, scalable systems — from ESP32 firmware to drone swarms to the cloud.
profile.summary: B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering. I work at the intersection of software engineering, AI, robotics and autonomous technologies — full-stack, backend, cloud, data engineering, IoT and embedded systems.

skills.note: Day-to-day languages across backend, embedded and web.
What I read and tinker with.

projects.title: Travel Insurance Chatbot
projects.blurb: A live chatbot at ICICI Lombard that guides customers through booking a travel insurance policy.
projects.story: Built as a software engineer at ICICI Lombard: a conversational flow that takes customers from questions to a booked travel insurance policy, running live on the company website.
highlights: Built and maintained as part of my role at ICICI Lombard

projects.title: PetroConnect
projects.blurb: IEEE-published automated fueling system with RFID authentication, ESP32 hardware and a MERN dashboard.
projects.story: Fueling stations rely on manual verification. PetroConnect authenticates users via RFID, talks to an ESP32 controller over a secured channel, and surfaces everything in a MERN web app.
highlights: ESP32 firmware with secure device communication

projects.title: Aegis-MAS
projects.blurb: Autonomous drone swarm exploring multi-agent communication and distributed decision-making.
projects.story: A swarm that plans missions and coordinates without a central brain — agents negotiate tasks, share state and adapt, simulated in Gazebo with PX4 and ROS 2.

projects.title: Customer Behaviour Analytics
projects.blurb: AWS data platform: ingestion, ETL pipelines, warehousing and analytics.
projects.story: End-to-end pipeline that ingests raw behavioural events, transforms them through ETL, lands them in a warehouse and exposes analytics.

projects.title: WanderWay
projects.blurb: A full-stack travel platform built on the MERN stack.
projects.story: A travel platform for discovering and planning trips, built end to end with the MERN stack.

projects.title: Donation Platform
projects.blurb: Web app with Razorpay payment processing, built during an internship at The Sparks Foundation.
projects.story: Built during my internship at The Sparks Foundation: a donation web app with secure Razorpay checkout.
